name: quick-presenter-relay-core

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of ['dist', 'protocol']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { cpSync } from 'node:fs'; cpSync('../../protocol', 'protocol', { recursive: true });"

description: Portable room core and protocol contracts for Quick Presenter Relay.
